title: Bluesteel
body:
Description


Bluesteel is a rare ore that only appears in Blueslate rocks, within any region of the map.

Bluesteel takes on a light azure color and exhibits the same geometry as Iron.

As with any other material in the game, both refined and forged Bluesteel can be used to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • Bluesteel is considered to be the rarest ore in all of Oaklands.
  • A Full trailer of Bluesteel would cost around 2.5-5 million dollars on the market.
